subject: Every lemma in the union of the two published Ukrainian A1/A2 lexical minimums and the validated Ukrainian Vocabulary Profile, joined on a corpus frequency spine, with each agreement and disagreement classified
method: Both sides joined by lemma string with the pedagogical stress accent stripped and the apostrophe folded across glyphs and the one HTML entity. Minimum membership is per headword, so every word an entry line names counts; a word in both volumes counts as A1. The profile level is the onset level of the lexeme's earliest sense, taken from the whole published profile rather than its top-12000 slice, so a minimum word off the frequency list can still be compared. Absent rows carry a deliberately over-matching relative flag (derivational family, substring, or shared stem) so the unflagged residue is conservative.
